description: This file defines the I18NImportErrorDecorator class, which provides helper methods to manipulate and set related entities within an I18NImportError object. It acts as a decorator/wrapper around the I18NImportError entity, facilitating setting related entities such as language, error, language string, and employee based on identifiers.

classes.name: I18NImportErrorDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for the I18NImportError entity, providing methods to set related entities such as language, error, language string, and employee.

methods.name: setImportError
methods.description: Sets the I18NImportError object to be decorated.

methods.name: setLangStringById
methods.description: Sets the language string of the import error based on the provided language string ID.

methods.name: setLanguageById
methods.description: Sets the language of the import error based on the provided language ID.

methods.name: setErrorByName
methods.description: Sets the error entity based on the provided error name.

methods.name: setImportedEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee who imported the data, based on the employee number.
